consulta: SELECT USER AS esquema, TO_CHAR(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM') AS fecha FROM dual

SELECT table_name,column_id,column_name,data_type,data_length,char_length,char_used,data_precision,data_scale,nullable FROM user_tab_columns WHERE table_name LIKE 'CRM\_%' ESCAPE '\' ORDER BY table_name,column_id

SELECT c.table_name,c.constraint_name,c.constraint_type,c.status,c.validated,c.delete_rule,cc.column_name,cc.position,p.table_name AS tabla_referida,pc.column_name AS columna_referida FROM user_constraints c LEFT JOIN user_cons_columns cc ON cc.constraint_name=c.constraint_name LEFT JOIN user_constraints p ON p.constraint_name=c.r_constraint_name LEFT JOIN user_cons_columns pc ON pc.constraint_name=p.constraint_name AND pc.position=cc.position WHERE c.table_name LIKE 'CRM\_%' ESCAPE '\' ORDER BY c.table_name,c.constraint_name,cc.position

SELECT i.table_name,i.index_name,i.index_type,i.uniqueness,i.status,ic.column_position,ic.column_name,ic.descend FROM user_indexes i JOIN user_ind_columns ic ON ic.index_name=i.index_name WHERE i.table_name LIKE 'CRM\_%' ESCAPE '\' ORDER BY i.table_name,i.index_name,ic.column_position
SELECT table_name,column_name,generation_type,sequence_name,identity_options FROM user_tab_identity_cols WHERE table_name LIKE 'CRM\_%' ESCAPE '\' ORDER BY table_name,column_name
SELECT table_name,constraint_name,search_condition_vc AS search_condition FROM user_constraints WHERE table_name LIKE 'CRM\_%' ESCAPE '\' AND constraint_type='C' ORDER BY table_name,constraint_name
